correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact pmf and rational pgf from the 2017 source. It distinguishes ordinary real-valued from integer-convolution divisibility at the zero-truncated endpoint, proves that positive-zero-mass laws have no noninteger convolution roots, and establishes a sharp numerator-root crossing for all theta>0. Positive canonical intensities are given constructively on the upper branch and after removing one deterministic unit at truncation. Strict negative even coefficients prove failure in the entire open gap. Exact algebra and an independent rational recurrence were reproduced from the embedded checker, while infinite claims rest on analytic inequalities.

value.rationale: The model explicitly accommodates zero deflation, and its jump-process representability is not settled by its given pmf or dispersion. The exact theorem shows a disconnected parameter set, with an isolated shifted infinitely divisible truncation endpoint, an open non-divisible zone, and a reentrant unshifted compound-Poisson zone. The proof also gives a parameter at which an overdispersed law is not infinitely divisible and shows why every predetermined finite set of canonical-coefficient diagnostics is inconclusive near the threshold. These are structurally motivated, model-specific exact results.
